# Albright Innovations

> Albright Innovations helps small and medium businesses get more customers and run more smoothly. We manage social media, Facebook and Instagram ads and websites, and we set up the systems behind the scenes: customer lists, phones, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, follow-up and lead tracking. We work with businesses in Big Rapids and West Michigan and in Charlotte, Waxhaw and Union County, North Carolina, and with remote clients anywhere in the United States.

Tagline: Authentic Influence. Founder: Joshua Albright. Email: joshua@albright-innovations.com. Website: https://albright-innovations.com/

## Services

- [Operations review](https://albright-innovations.com/how-we-work/): A walk-through of how work moves through your business, from the first call to the final invoice, and where time and leads slip away.
- [Tools set up and connected](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): Customer list, scheduling, phones, quoting, invoicing and job tracking, picked to fit how you work and connected so information is entered once.
- [Workflows and follow-up](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): Clear steps from first call to close to follow-up, so nothing depends on someone remembering.
- [Lead tracking and dashboards](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): Every call, message and form tracked to a source, with the numbers you care about in one place.
- [Social media management](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): Posts planned, scheduled and answered, so your page stays active without you living on it.
- [Social ads](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): Facebook and Instagram ads aimed at people near you who are ready to buy.
- [Websites](https://albright-innovations.com/#services): A clean, current site that tells people who you are, what you do and how to reach you.

## Free tools

- [Where does your week go?](https://albright-innovations.com/#time): Add up the hours you spend on quotes, scheduling, invoicing, retyping and social media, and see what they cost per year.
- [Missed-call calculator](https://albright-innovations.com/#calls): Estimate the jobs and revenue at risk from unanswered calls and slow follow-up.
- [2-minute operations checkup](https://albright-innovations.com/#checkup): Nine quick questions, a score out of 100, and the three fixes worth doing first.

## Answers to common questions

- [How much time do small business owners spend on admin?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-much-time-do-small-business-owners-spend-on-admin/): Most owners spend 15 to 20 hours a week on admin. One survey of 251 U.S. business owners put it at 36% of a 45.5-hour week, which works out to about 16 hours.
- [What does a missed call cost a small business?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-a-missed-call-cost-a-small-business/): A missed call costs you the chance of a job: the share of callers who don't try again, times how often a call becomes work, times your average job value. For a business getting 30 calls a week and missing 40% of them, that's roughly 21 jobs a month at risk.
- [How fast should I respond to a new lead?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-fast-should-i-respond-to-a-new-lead/): Within five minutes if you can, and within the hour at the latest. Businesses that reach a new lead within an hour are nearly seven times more likely to qualify it than those that wait even an hour longer.
- [Do I need a CRM for a small business, and what's the simplest place to start?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/do-i-need-a-crm-for-a-small-business/): If you have more than a few dozen customers, yes, but it doesn't need to be fancy. A CRM is a customer list with the history attached, and the simplest place to start is one shared spreadsheet with six columns.
- [How often should a local business post on Facebook?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-often-should-a-local-business-post-on-facebook/): At least once a week, so the page looks alive to someone checking you out, and two to three times a week if you want it to bring in work. Consistency matters more than volume.
- [Is it worth paying someone to manage our social media?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/is-it-worth-paying-someone-to-manage-our-social-media/): It's worth it when the hours you'd spend are worth more than the fee, or when the posting isn't happening at all. Three hours a week at $75 an hour is $11,700 a year of your time.
- [How do I know which ads or posts are bringing in customers?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-do-i-know-which-ads-or-posts-bring-in-customers/): Give each ad or post its own trail: a separate phone number, a tagged link, or a "how did you hear about us" that gets written down every single time. Then match each job back to the trail it came in on.
- [When is it time to redo my business website?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/when-is-it-time-to-redo-my-business-website/): When it no longer does its three jobs: tell people what you do, show them you're real and current, and make it easy to reach you. If it's more than three years old, awkward on a phone, or shows old hours, prices or photos, it's time.
- [What should a small business website have on it?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-should-a-small-business-website-have-on-it/): Six things: what you do, where you do it, proof you're real (your photos, your name, your reviews), a way to contact you on every page, current hours and prices where they apply, and a site that works on a phone.
- [What does an operations review involve?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-an-operations-review-involve/): A walk-through of how work moves through your business, from the first call to the final invoice. The first conversation takes about 30 minutes, and you get a one-page list of what we'd fix first.
- [Do you work with businesses outside Big Rapids or Charlotte?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/do-you-work-with-businesses-outside-big-rapids-or-charlotte/): Yes. We're based in Big Rapids, Michigan and Waxhaw, North Carolina, and most of the work happens online, so we work with businesses anywhere in the United States.
- [What does it cost to work with Albright Innovations?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-it-cost-to-work-with-albright-innovations/): It depends on the scope, and we figure it out together before you commit to anything. The first conversation and the operations check don't cost anything, and you'll have a price in writing before any work starts.
